note: Code derivation: item IS the source column name (icar_p.csv ships VR4..R3D8 and the deposit's own items PDF labels each item with the same ICAR code, printed with a dot: VR.4 -> VR4). Deposit Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.23035572 (CC BY 4.0 on the record and on the article), a snapshot of the authors' GitHub repo at v1.0.3; the zip is pinned by sha256 in data/tolomeo_2026_icar16.py and this batch reads the same cached copy. Italian item_text and option_text transcribed verbatim from the deposit's 'ICAR 16 ITEMS.pdf' text layer, which carries its diacritics and typographic apostrophes intact, and checked against the rendered page images. Built by itemtables/batch_icar16_2026-10-27/build_icar16_items.py, which asserts 16 items, the expected option count per item (6 except VR16's 4 and the four R3D items' 8) and 102 rows. NO KEY: the PDF is titled 'Italian ICAR-16 Sample Test Items and Keys' and prints no key -- not in the text layer, not marked on the rendered pages, and not in the English codebook or either R script -- so correct_response is empty and key_source is empty. The ICAR publishes keys for these item codes separately; nothing was inferred here. resp is EMPTY and resp_raw carries the printed option label (i..viii): the response table scores 0/1 for correctness and the deposit records no option-level response, so no option can be tied to a resp value. validate_items.R --table-sets: item sets match exactly (16), resp_raw route taken deliberately. The MR and R3D items are figures. Their stems are transcribed verbatim and their options are the labels the PDF prints beside 'Options:' (A-F, A-H); the figures are not reproduced and nothing was read out of them, which is why description_source is empty. In the R3D items two of the eight options are text panels inside the figure rather than cubes; their wording is NOT transcribed, for the same reason.
public_note: Item wording is the Italian as administered, transcribed from the deposit's own items PDF. The matrix-reasoning (MR) and cube-rotation (R3D) items are figures that are not reproduced here: their option_text is the letter label the source prints (A-F, A-H), not a description of the picture. No scoring key is published anywhere in the deposit, so correct_response is empty, and resp is empty with the option's printed label in resp_raw -- the response table scores items 0/1 for correctness and records no option-level response.
